posts.title: Can a Sticker Heal You? The Pseudoscience Behind Biofrequency Patches
posts.description: Can a copper sticker really help with PTSD, anxiety, or migraines? When a company asked me to promote its biofrequency patches, I investigated the science behind these supposed healing frequencies. What I found raises serious questions about the physics, clinical evidence, and marketing. Here's what you need to know before spending your money.

posts.title: Bipolar Medication Tolerance: Why Medications Stop Working
posts.description: Why do bipolar medications sometimes seem to stop working? This article explains medication tolerance, antidepressant tachyphylaxis, lithium re-treatment problems, breakthrough mood episodes, and other reasons treatment may lose effectiveness—plus what to discuss with your doctor before changing a medication.

posts.title: Does Keto Cure Bipolar? Does Keto Treat Bipolar? Current Research
posts.description: Keto for bipolar disorder is getting attention in metabolic psychiatry, but what does the research actually show? Here’s what current studies say about ketogenic diets, bipolar symptoms, possible benefits, serious risks, and why keto is not a proven replacement for standard bipolar treatment.
